add_executable(ProjectEulerSolutions
  1.multiples-of-3-and-5/1.multiples_of_3_and_5_test.cpp
)

target_include_directories(ProjectEulerSolutions
  PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)

target_link_libraries(ProjectEulerSolutions
  PRIVATE
    Catch2::Catch2WithMain
)

# Suppress clang-tidy warnings generated by Catch2 macro expansions in test files
set_target_properties(ProjectEulerSolutions PROPERTIES CXX_CLANG_TIDY "")

# Automatically locate and copy the ASan DLL on Windows
if(WIN32 AND CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
  # Ask Clang dynamically where its internal libraries are located
  execute_process(
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER} -print-resource-dir
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
  )

  # Build the path to the ASan DLL relative to the dynamic resource dir
  set(ASAN_DLL "${CLANG_RESOURCE_DIR}/lib/windows/clang_rt.asan_dynamic-x86_64.dll")

  # Copy the DLL into the same folder as the test executable
  if(EXISTS "${ASAN_DLL}")
    add_custom_command(TARGET ProjectEulerSolutions POST_BUILD
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
      "${ASAN_DLL}"
      $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:ProjectEulerSolutions>
      COMMENT "Dynamically copying ASan DLL from compiler resources"
    )
  endif()
endif()

include(CTest)
include(Catch)

catch_discover_tests(ProjectEulerSolutions)
